Who I am

My name is Ritchel A. Buncio

I am a Senior High School student taking the Computer Systems Servicing (CSS) track. I chose this track because I am interested in computers and technology and I want to learn more about how computer systems work. Through CSS, I am developing my skills in computer hardware, software installation, troubleshooting, basic networking, and other technical skills that can help me in my future career.

My experiences as an SHS student have taught me to be responsible, patient, hardworking, and willing to learn, especially when facing challenges. I know that there is still a lot for me to learn, but I am determined to improve my skills and gain more knowledge through practice and experience. I hope to use what I learn from the CSS track as a foundation for my future career in the technology field and continue growing into a skilled, responsible, and confident professional.

These photos show some of the most meaningful moments I have shared with my family, who have always been an important part of my life and my journey. Every picture holds a special memory of the times we spent together, whether it was during a celebration, a simple gathering, or an ordinary day that became special because we were together. My family has given me so many reasons to smile, laugh, and keep going, and through them, I have learned the importance of love, support, understanding, and being grateful for the people who are always there for me.

As I look back at these moments, I realize that the happiest memories are not always about where we are or what we have, but about being surrounded by the people we love. These experiences have helped me appreciate my family even more and have given me memories that I will continue to treasure as I grow older. No matter how much time passes or how life changes, these moments will always remind me of where I came from, the people who shaped me, and the love and memories that will always be a part of me.

My Goal

Career

My goal is to pursue a career in Information Technology (IT) because I am interested in computers, technology, and learning how different systems work. As a Senior High School student taking the Computer Systems Servicing (CSS) track, I am gaining knowledge and skills that can help prepare me for this career, such as computer hardware, software installation, troubleshooting, basic networking, and other technical skills. I want to continue improving these skills and gain more experience so I can become a responsible, capable, and skilled IT professional in the future.

I know that working in the IT field requires patience, problem-solving, creativity, and continuous learning because technology is always changing. I am willing to face challenges, learn from my mistakes, and improve myself along the way. My experiences as an SHS student are helping me build confidence and prepare for the future I want. Through hard work, determination, and dedication, I hope to achieve my goals, build a successful career in IT, and make my family proud.
